collection.title: Toyota Yaris/Vitz GR 2020 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Toyota Yaris GR 2020 Onwards model requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 16" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Standard Hook arm attachment. There is also the option to upgrade to the newer Retorfit style blade. We also have rear blade for this Yaris, simply click on the Rear Blades tab below.
